vBRIEFInfo.description: Ship the conception-to-ship Directive lifecycle conceptual diagram into consumer installs by relocating it from the maintainer-only docs/ tree into the shipped content/docs/ tree.

plan.title: Ship the Directive lifecycle conceptual diagram to consumer installs

narratives.Description: The single-picture conception-to-ship lifecycle overview (Concept -> Strategy Analysis -> Specification + Artifacts feeding the recurring Session Start -> Triage/Refine -> Slice -> Swarm -> Review/Fix -> Ship loop) lives at docs/directive-lifecycle.md with its PNG at docs/assets/. The top-level docs/ tree is NOT part of the npm consumer payload (packages/content prepack copies only content/ -> .deft/core/ plus engine surfaces), so consumers never receive this orientation diagram. content/docs/ DOES ship (it becomes .deft/core/docs/). This scope relocates the doc and its asset into content/docs/, rewrites the relative links for the shipped layout, and cross-links it from the consumer-facing getting-started guide so new adopters can see the overall shape of the framework.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- git mv docs/directive-lifecycle.md -> content/docs/directive-lifecycle.md and docs/assets/directive-lifecycle-diagram.png -> content/docs/assets/directive-lifecycle-diagram.png.
- Rewrite the relocated doc's relative links for the content/docs/ position: content-tree siblings (strategies/, skills/) via ../, framework-only docs (CONCEPTS/ARCHITECTURE/FILES) via ../../docs/ matching the existing content/docs/getting-started.md convention, image via ./assets/.
- Add a cross-link to the lifecycle diagram from content/docs/getting-started.md so the consumer orientation layer surfaces it.
- Add a back-reference from docs/CONCEPTS.md (or ARCHITECTURE.md See also) to the relocated path so maintainer discoverability is preserved.
- Add a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry.
narratives.UserStory: As a developer who has just installed Deft Directive into my project, I want the conception-to-ship lifecycle diagram available in my install, so that I can understand the overall shape of the framework without visiting the upstream framework repo.
narratives.Traces: Follow-up from conversational finding that docs/directive-lifecycle.md does not ship to consumer repos.
